Daily Devotional

February 27

11 Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel? (Ezekiel 33:11 KJV)

Ezekiel, the prophet, was sent to bring the news of God’s judgment upon Israel, and even during a time of judging the nation, God offers to withhold His judgment if they would only repent and turn from their evil ways. This shows just what a loving and good God we have, as He wishes to offer mercy to all that will repent of their evil ways. This shows how that our God is pure love (1 John 4:8), and His mercy, and grace, are without end.

God makes it clear also in Ezekiel (Ezekiel 18:23 and 32) that He wishes they would not make Him bring this judgment upon them. God is so longsuffering and so full of divine love that He does not want to have to bring judgment on any of us. No wonder John wrote in 1 John 4:8 that God is love. Let us praise God and Jesus every day for their love and mercy to us undeserving humans, for we have all sinned and come short of the glory of God (Romans 3:23). We need to learn this lesson from our Father, and be quick to forgive those that offend us (Matthew 6:14). Thank you Lord for forgiving us, and for your wonderful love.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
